scripts.dev:fresh: npm run dev:stop && powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-dev-services.ps1
scripts.dev:services: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all --names backend,dependents --prefix-colors magenta,cyan "npm run dev:backend" "npm run dev:after-backend"
scripts.dev:dependent-services: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --success all --names frontend,python-rails,knowgraph,mcp,tunnel,worldview,hermes-webapp --prefix-colors green,cyan,blue,white,gray,magenta,yellow "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-dependent-services.ps1 -StartFrontendAfterApplicationReadiness" "npm run dev:python-rails" "npm run dev:knowgraph" "npm run dev:mcp" "powershell -NoProfile -ExecutionPolicy Bypass -File scripts/start-dependent-services.ps1 -WaitForMcpReadiness" "npm run dev:worldview" "npm run dev:hermes-webapp"
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace client && npm run typecheck --workspace apps/backend
scripts.typecheck:spec: npm run typecheck:spec --workspace client && npm run typecheck:spec --workspace apps/backend
scripts.typecheck:all: npm run typecheck && npm run typecheck:spec
